parameters.content:
StartCollaborativeBuild
  ├─ Generate sessionId
  ├─ Save to DB
  └─ Execute: SpawnWorkers (pass taskDivision too)
      ↓
SpawnWorkers
  ├─ Spawn workers (workerCount: 3)
  ├─ Append to spawnedWorkers array
  └─ Execute: WaitAndRegister (pass taskDivision)
      ↓
WaitAndRegister
  ├─ Wait for workers ready
  ├─ Register workers
  └─ Execute: CoordinateBuild (pass taskDivision)
      ↓
CoordinateBuild
  ├─ Create session
  ├─ Get position
  ├─ Reserve location
  ├─ Teleport workers
  └─ Execute: DistributeTasks (pass taskDivision) ← HERE!
      ↓
DistributeTasks
  ├─ Function: Convert taskDivision to array
  ├─ Loop through tasks
  ├─ HTTP POST send-task to each worker
  └─ Complete

Worker1.objective: Build complete shelter structure with foundation, walls, roof, and entrance
Worker1.assumptions: You are positioned at the build area. Ground is clear and ready. You have sufficient inventory.
Worker1.constraints: Stay within defined bounds. Do NOT break natural terrain outside shelter footprint. Do NOT leave incomplete structures.

Worker1.subtask: Prepare foundation and clear ground for shelter base
Worker1.objective: Build complete shelter with walls, roof, and entrance
constraints: Do NOT place blocks outside x:452-457 range
Do NOT place blocks outside z:-124 to -116 range
Foundation must form complete outline at y:-60
Worker1.fullPrompt:
STAGE 1 OF 4: FOUNDATION & GROUND PREPARATION

You are already positioned at your build area. Begin immediately.

OBJECTIVE: Prepare the foundation for a 6x8 shelter.

COORDINATES (Foundation Level):
- X Range: 452 to 457 (6 blocks wide)
- Z Range: -124 to -116 (8 blocks deep)
- Y Level: -60 (ground level)

TASK:
1. Place cobblestone outline at y:-60:
   - Perimeter outline: x:452-457, z:-124 and z:-116 (north/south walls)
   - Side walls: z:-124 to -116, x:452 and x:457 (east/west walls)
   - Total: 48 cobblestone blocks forming complete rectangle

2. Prepare interior floor area:
   - Flatten and level ground at x:452-457, z:-124 to -116, y:-60
   - Fill any gaps with dirt blocks as needed
   - Ensure flat surface for floor placement

MATERIALS ASSUMED IN INVENTORY:
- cobblestone: 48 blocks
- dirt: 24 blocks

DO NOT:
- Dig below y:-60
- Place blocks outside x:452-457
- Place blocks outside z:-124 to -116
- Build above y:-60 (foundation only)
- Leave gaps in foundation outline

BEGIN IMMEDIATELY. Stage 1 complete when foundation outline is solid and ground is level.

Worker1.objective: Build complete shelter with walls, roof, and entrance
constraints: Do NOT place blocks at y:-60 (foundation already complete)
Do NOT place blocks outside x:452-457
Do NOT place blocks outside z:-124 to -116
Walls must be 3 blocks high (y:-59 to y:-57)
Leave 2-block gap on south wall for door
Worker1.fullPrompt:
STAGE 2 OF 4: FLOOR & WALLS

You are already positioned at your build area. Begin immediately.

OBJECTIVE: Build interior floor and complete wall structure.

COORDINATES:
- X Range: 452 to 457 (6 blocks wide)
- Z Range: -124 to -116 (8 blocks deep)
- Y Range: -59 to -57 (floor + 3-block walls)

TASK:
1. Place floor using oak_planks at y:-59:
   - Fill entire interior: x:452-457, z:-124 to -116, y:-59
   - Total: 48 oak_planks (6×8 area)

2. Build walls using oak_planks, 3 blocks high (y:-59 to y:-57):
   - North wall: x:452-457, z:-124, y:-59 to -57 (18 blocks)
   - South wall: x:452-454 and x:456-457, z:-116, y:-59 to -57 (leave gap at x:455 for door)
   - West wall: z:-124 to -116, x:452, y:-59 to -57 (24 blocks)
   - East wall: z:-124 to -116, x:457, y:-59 to -57 (24 blocks)
   - Total walls: 66 oak_planks

3. Add 2 window panes on north wall:
   - x:453, z:-124, y:-58 (1 pane)
   - x:456, z:-124, y:-58 (1 pane)

4. Add 2 window panes on east wall:
   - x:457, z:-120, y:-58 (1 pane)
   - x:457, z:-122, y:-58 (1 pane)

MATERIALS ASSUMED IN INVENTORY:
- oak_planks: 96 blocks
- glass_pane: 12 blocks

DO NOT:
- Place blocks at y:-60 (foundation level - already done)
- Place blocks outside x:452-457
- Place blocks outside z:-124 to -116
- Fill the 2-block gap at x:455, z:-116 (door opening)
- Build above y:-57 (walls top level)

BEGIN IMMEDIATELY. Stage 2 complete when floor is solid and walls are 3 blocks high with door gap open.

Worker1.objective: Build complete shelter with walls, roof, and entrance
constraints: Do NOT place blocks below y:-56
Do NOT place blocks outside x:452-457
Do NOT place blocks outside z:-124 to -116
Roof peak must be at y:-54 (center)
Both sides must slope symmetrically toward center
Worker1.fullPrompt:
STAGE 3 OF 4: ROOF STRUCTURE

You are already positioned at your build area. Begin immediately.

OBJECTIVE: Build pitched roof with peak at center.

ROOF RIDGE LOCATION:
- Ridge Center X: 455 (midpoint of 452-457)
- Ridge Center Z: -120 (midpoint of -124 to -116)
- Ridge Peak Y: -54 (top of roof)

COORDINATES:
- X Range: 452 to 457 (6 blocks wide)
- Z Range: -124 to -116 (8 blocks deep)
- Y Range: -56 to -54 (roof layers)

TASK:
1. Build west roof slope using oak_stairs facing EAST (ascending toward ridge):
   - Layer 1 (y:-56): x:452, z:-124 to -116 (8 stairs)
   - Layer 2 (y:-55): x:453, z:-124 to -116 (8 stairs)
   - Layer 3 (y:-54): x:454, z:-124 to -116 (8 stairs)
   - All stairs face EAST (ascending toward ridge at x:455)

2. Build east roof slope using oak_stairs facing WEST (ascending toward ridge):
   - Layer 1 (y:-56): x:457, z:-124 to -116 (8 stairs)
   - Layer 2 (y:-55): x:456, z:-124 to -116 (8 stairs)
   - Layer 3 (y:-54): x:455, z:-124 to -116 (8 stairs)
   - All stairs face WEST (ascending toward ridge)

3. Place ridge cap using oak_slabs at y:-54:
   - Ridge cap slabs at x:455, z:-124 to -116, y:-54 (6 slabs)
   - All slabs face UP (capping the ridge peak)

MATERIALS ASSUMED IN INVENTORY:
- oak_stairs: 32 blocks (for slopes)
- oak_slab: 6 blocks (for ridge cap)

DO NOT:
- Place blocks below y:-56
- Place blocks outside x:452-457
- Place blocks outside z:-124 to -116
- Place roof blocks at interior floor level (y:-59 to -57)
- Leave gaps in roof coverage
- Place stairs facing wrong direction

BEGIN IMMEDIATELY. Stage 3 complete when roof slopes meet at center ridge with cap in place.

Worker1.subtask: Install door and add interior details
Worker1.objective: Build complete shelter with walls, roof, and entrance
constraints: Do NOT place door outside x:454-456, z:-116
Do NOT break any walls or roof
Do NOT place blocks outside shelter bounds
Torches must be on walls only (not floor)
Worker1.fullPrompt:
STAGE 4 OF 4: DOOR & INTERIOR DETAILS

You are already positioned at your build area. Begin immediately.

OBJECTIVE: Complete shelter by adding door, lighting, and basic interior furnishings.

COORDINATES:
- X Range: 452 to 457 (6 blocks wide)
- Z Range: -124 to -116 (8 blocks deep)
- Y Range: -59 to -57 (interior level)

TASK:
1. Install oak_door at south wall entrance:
   - Location: x:455, z:-116
   - Bottom block: y:-59
   - Top block: y:-58
   - Door facing: NORTH (opens into shelter)

2. Place torches for lighting (4 total):
   - Northwest corner: x:452, z:-124, y:-57 (attached to north wall)
   - Northeast corner: x:457, z:-124, y:-57 (attached to north wall)
   - Southwest corner: x:452, z:-116, y:-57 (attached to west wall)
   - Southeast corner: x:457, z:-116, y:-57 (attached to east wall)

3. Place crafting_table:
   - Location: x:453, z:-118, y:-59

4. Place furnace:
   - Location: x:456, z:-118, y:-59

MATERIALS ASSUMED IN INVENTORY:
- oak_door: 1 (2-block structure)
- torch: 4 blocks
- crafting_table: 1 block
- furnace: 1 block

DO NOT:
- Place blocks outside x:452-457
- Place blocks outside z:-124 to -116
- Break walls or roof
- Place torches on floor
- Place door outside south wall entrance
- Place items outside interior bounds

BEGIN IMMEDIATELY. Stage 4 complete when door is installed, 4 torches light interior, and furnishings are placed. Shelter is finished.
